feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 May 2026 5:27pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 13 May 2026 at 5:25pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, and low pressure to the west of Norway, with various troughs affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, gradually decreasing north or northwest 4 or 5 overnight, but still 6 in the west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, with isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or possibly poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or north-northwest 5 but 6 in the west of the area and occasionally 4 in the east. Becoming northwest 4 or 5 in all waters during Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, with occasional showers at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
